integrity: The covariance is reconstructed directly from symbol-presence indicators and one adjacent-change indicator. Strict positivity follows from a Cauchy--Schwarz monotonicity argument for a tilted probability-weight ratio. Independent rational-arithmetic enumeration verifies the identity on nonuniform and uniform finite cases.
scientific_limitations: The sequence is iid on a finite alphabet; dependent and fixed-composition models are not covered.
The result concerns covariance and a one-pair conditional mean gap, not the full joint law or general positive association.
Older multivariate run or occupancy generating functions could encode the same mixed moment under different notation.
title: Categorical coverage and run count have universal positive covariance
